candidate_practices.name: Specify the changed information contract
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts specify which information is unavailable, newly usable, or reorganized.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes capability changes assessable without relying on priority language.
candidate_practices.application: Replace 'novel framework' with the old input assumption, changed information access, and resulting operation.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the contribution changes analysis or measurement without changing information access.

support.specific_example: ASBS avoids target-sample estimation and relaxes a memoryless condition to accommodate arbitrary sources.
Online attribution replaces fixed-dataset assumptions with recent-buffer checkpoint attribution and action/return targets.
IDeal replaces complete-query assumptions with interaction, then addresses interactive-text domain mismatch.
Masking and recovery unify task interfaces; evaluation distinguishes task, zero-shot region, and few-shot region transfer.

contrasts.contrast: ConML repurposes task identity already exposed by episodic training; additional supervision need not mean additional collection.
ControlFusion combines user specifications with image-derived degradation information rather than replacing either source.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Actual input requirements, leakage controls, interaction costs, and transfer protocols.

candidate_practices.name: Explain what each representation carries
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts describe represented information and its destination, beyond listing modules.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: information flow can explain why the architecture fits the task.
candidate_practices.application: Describe each central representation as encoding a named relation and supplying a named downstream operation.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When internal representations are uninterpreted or their proposed roles remain speculative.

support.specific_example: Trajectories feed a global map; viewpoint transformations answer spatial questions.
Hierarchical indexing supports graph granularities, task-aware retrieval, and topology-aware fusion.
Projected CLIP features form patch-instance-zone representations with online localization and updates.
Semantic and adjacent-clip phase information meet in a pretrained motion-frequency latent domain.

contrasts.contrast: SAGE emphasizes concepts shareable across objects/actions; reuse, rather than hierarchy, motivates its representation.
MokA separates unimodal compression and cross-modal interaction without specifying a spatial hierarchy.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Whether representations encode the claimed relations and which operations account for results.

candidate_practices.name: Derive the repair from a specific distortion
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts connect an objective or hardware property to an unwanted effect and a targeted modification.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this distinguishes a motivated repair from an unexplained extra loss.
candidate_practices.application: Write the original term or distortion, its claimed consequence, and the exact modification consecutively.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the diagnosis is unsupported; label a hypothesis instead of presenting established causation.

support.specific_example: LS decomposition identifies misclassification amplification; MaxSup penalizes the top-1 logit.
Opposing JMMD/HSIC graph-weight signs motivate a combined discrimination-preserving objective.
Asymmetric hardware responses induce an implicit penalty, motivating bilevel residual learning.
Expert overlap and uniform routing motivate orthogonality/variance losses, with separate gradient-compatibility analysis.

contrasts.contrast: ALFAR pairs diagnosed attention bias and knowledge conflict with interventions, but the extraction supplies no causal verification.
FedCBDR motivates sampling and temperature scaling from imbalance locations, without an extracted loss decomposition.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Derivations, diagnostic measurements, and evidence separating intervention effects.

candidate_practices.name: Locate the mathematical change relative to prior objects
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts identify a changed quantity, controlled dependency, or removed complexity term.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the reader can locate the advance without treating every theorem as interchangeable support.
candidate_practices.application: Name the prior mathematical object and precisely what the new definition or analysis changes.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the relationship is only analogical or requires assumptions the abstract cannot responsibly summarize.

support.specific_example: Average velocity is distinguished from instantaneous velocity and connected through a training identity.
Improved GP-UCB regret is linked to concentration of algorithm-generated inputs and information-gain control.
Active-learning improvement is located in removal of disagreement-related leading-term factors.
Optimized overlap geometry connects FP criteria to SQ bounds under an assumption, simplifying known derivations and enabling others.

contrasts.contrast: Clipped Scion presents descent, a weight-decay interpretation, and stochastic convergence as distinct mathematical results.
PhySense separates reconstruction feedback from objective consistency with variance minimization; consistency is not equivalence.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Exact assumptions, theorem statements, improvement terms, and validity of mathematical correspondences.

candidate_practices.name: Make the conclusion conditional on a regime variable
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts distinguish favorable, unfavorable, or differently scaling regimes.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: a conditional conclusion can guide parameter or method choice.
candidate_practices.application: State the regime variable followed by separate outcomes, preserving necessary/sufficient and all/some distinctions.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When only one regime was studied or boundaries are unsupported.

support.specific_example: State entropy has unfavorable settings and greater rollout-count sensitivity than policy entropy.
Slope choices show no clear supervised preference but reported RL improvements.
Weak superposition needs power-law feature frequencies; strong superposition supports broader inverse-dimension scaling.
A learning-rate threshold separates all-instance logarithmic regret from possible polynomial regret; general K requires inverse-K scaling.

contrasts.contrast: Escape, condensation, and rank collapse are sequential training stages, not selectable operating settings.
Collapse, clustering, and merging concern inference-depth dynamics under joint N–β scaling, not training.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Threshold formulas, phase boundaries, statistical uncertainty, and extrapolation limits.

candidate_practices.name: Match evidence to the disputed interpretation
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts use comparisons that address explanatory or measurement questions beyond aggregate performance.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: evidence becomes relevant to the specific claim rather than merely favorable.
candidate_practices.application: Identify what the existing observation cannot distinguish, then report the comparison that addresses that ambiguity.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the intervention changes inseparable factors or the measurement cannot identify the proposed explanation.

support.specific_example: Stochastic and closed-form flow losses are compared at both loss and model-performance levels.
Controlled cue suppression revisits cue-conflict interpretation and reveals domain-dependent reliance.
A solvable model separates latent from embedding dimension; NCE reports different outcomes across stimulus conditions.
Task performance is related to neural alignment, then self-supervised neural fits are compared with supervised fits.

contrasts.contrast: GnnXemplar reports fidelity/scalability and a 60-person interpretability study as different evidence targets.
Sparse-attention timing combines toy-model analysis, variable-dependent predictions, and an associative-recall check.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Measurement definitions, confounds, comparison protocols, and whether reported associations support stronger explanations.

candidate_practices.name: Attach gains to resource conditions
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts pair performance claims with execution, training, or inference resource descriptions.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can distinguish increased capability from changes in allocated computation.
candidate_practices.application: Put the baseline, gain, resource unit, and operating constraint in the same result sentence.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When resource measurements are unavailable; avoid substituting iteration counts for wall-clock evidence.

support.specific_example: RHEL reports three forward passes and BPTT-matching performance on sequences reaching roughly 50,000.
REG names baselines and iteration budgets alongside speedups and below-0.5% inference overhead.
ElasticMM reports TTFT and throughput gains while meeting SLOs.
Execution strategies report maximum and average gains across 17 tasks with extra wall-clock seconds.

contrasts.contrast: Depth scaling reports numerical and behavioral changes; depth alone does not establish compute efficiency.
ACN reports architectural compression with maintained accuracy; compression is not a measured latency reduction.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Hardware, budgets, quality thresholds, workload distributions, and denominator definitions.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Unify formulation, hardness, approximation, heuristics, and application around opinion intervals.
unusual_but_useful.application: Keep multiple contributions when they answer the same formal question.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Expressiveness and political-leaning validation remain undefined.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Treat benchmark task coverage as a contribution.
unusual_but_useful.application: Specify newly measurable relations and annotation demands.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Priority and benchmark quality need checking.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Combine a generalist model, reward objective, distinct task metrics, and released artifacts.
unusual_but_useful.application: Separate each contribution's scope and evidence.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Visual-domain macro-F1 does not establish every modality claim.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Pair restricted asymptotic bounds with finite constructions.
unusual_but_useful.application: State compatibility assumptions beside lower bounds; separate the maxout construction.
unusual_but_useful.limit: No unrestricted ReLU depth conclusion follows.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Define system capability through temporal, spatial, and depth resolution.
unusual_but_useful.application: Replace vague resolution claims with six-hourly, 1/12°, and 1500-meter specifications.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Resolution does not specify forecast horizon or accuracy.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Connect repaired bounds to a memorization implication.
unusual_but_useful.application: Separate selected-instance rates from the auxiliary-algorithm statement.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Comparable generalization error does not imply comparable task accuracy.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Instantiate a reduction and add a necessity result.
unusual_but_useful.application: Present the general guarantee, simplex case, and lower-bound condition separately.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Exponential dependencies alone do not establish matching bounds.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Every abstract needs an explicit prior-method gap and ORAL sequence.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Proposal-led and scope-led theory abstracts offer useful alternatives; selection causes are unavailable.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Useful contributions must beat a baseline.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Equivalence, explanatory exclusion, and new measurement resources can carry the contribution.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Each module fixes an independently established cause.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Abstract-level design mappings do not establish causal isolation.
